summary: Designed a deterministic control-plane barrier: a dev-gated task-hold at the recordLaunch<->executeAndDrainForTask lease seam that holds each capacity lease (brain.LifecycleCapacity TryBegin/promote/Finish) open WITHOUT spawning the agent/LLM, releasing on explicit signal (fs marker / control endpoint / in-proc test channel) or a mandatory bounded timeout, then a synthetic terminal -> recordTerminal -> capacity.Finish (exactly-once release). Gated by AGENT_BRAIN_DEVELOPMENT_ENABLED + CapacityTier20 + AGENT_BRAIN_T20_BARRIER_HOLD/TIMEOUT_MS, fail-closed and production-off. A barrier coordinator drives the T20-workload 20 tasks: assert Snapshot().Active==20 simultaneously, never > Limit()==20, ledger reconciles, release -> Active==0 with each lease Finished exactly once, and e2e Assemble.AllContinuous. Proves concurrency/capacity/cancel/trace deterministically without inference.
